Class: Icon

Properties
Name Type Description
src String Source of the image. It can be an URL or an folder path. Defaults to bemap.Icon.DEFAULT_SRC, an inline SVG pin — no network request, so it also works offline and on a closed network.
anchorX double .
anchorY double .
anchorXUnits String Units of the anchorX.
anchorYUnits String Units of the anchorY.
opacity float a number between 0 and 1 to define the opacity of the icon. 1 to full opacity and 0 to full transparency.

Members

(static, constant) DEFAULT_SRC :String

Default marker image, used when no `src` is given. An inline SVG `data:` URI rather than a URL. The previous default pointed at `openlayers.org/en/v3.18.2/examples/data/icon.png` — a third-party host, over plain HTTP, in the example data of a long-abandoned OpenLayers release. On an HTTPS page Chrome upgrades that request and the upgrade fails too, so the marker never appeared and nothing was thrown (BEMAP-1908). A `data:` URI is used deliberately: it needs no network, so it works offline and on a customer's closed network, it sends nothing to a third party, and it adds no file to ship or host. The shape is a 25x41 pin whose tip sits at the bottom centre, matching the `anchorX: 0.5` / `anchorY: 1` defaults above. Spaces and `#` are percent-encoded so the URI stays valid in a CSS context (Leaflet) as well as in an `Image.src` (OpenLayers) and `loadImage` (MapLibre).
